prompt:
A high oblique DRONE establishing shot of a scenic mountain road trip at sunrise, portrait 9:16. The camera floats about 40 meters ABOVE the mountain road and well BACK from the couple's car. It looks diagonally DOWN at roughly 20-25 degrees below horizontal with a wide 24 mm lens. Lavender-peach sky, low sun at left and distant misty ridgelines fill the upper third. This is a flying view over a large open landscape.

Show broad TOP SURFACES of a pale sage-green vintage convertible and the winding asphalt road. Its tan seats hold one adult Indian couple, groom driving on the right, bride beside him. People are tiny at this height; never resolve new faces. Both have warm medium-brown skin and dark hair. Olive and ivory travel clothes for him, teal jacket and maroon skirt for her. A cream scarf tied to the passenger headrest is the small recurring travel clue. No logos, letters or license-plate text.

A mountain road bends along the cliff from lower left toward a distant waterfall and its natural rock basin, all clearly part of the same terrain. The car points toward that waterfall, still small in the landscape. See the lower switchback road beneath the near verge and the river running toward the far coast. Keep the sky and horizon with clear downward perspective; neither an eye-level car advertisement nor a vertical overhead map.

Wild grass and tiny mountain flowers line the verges. Mist hangs in the valley; sunlight reveals rock strata and long shadows. An open natural stopping area and small devotional boulder beside the waterfall lie on the upcoming route, not separately pasted scenery. The forward-down flight route is clear and follows the road. Warm directional reflections on paint, premium dimensional storybook illustration. No wedding decorations at this travel stage, no text or extra car.
